title: Product Security Engineer II - IAM
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 About the InfoSec team
The InfoSec team protects Affirm’s systems and data from evolving threats. We manage security risk, monitor vulnerabilities, and enforce protective controls across the company. The team leads incident response, compliance, identity and access management, and employee training. Our goal is to ensure that security is built into every system and decision at Affirm. We maintain a secure, trustworthy environment so the business can operate and grow with confidence.
 About the role
We are building the next generation of enterprise Identity and Access Management at Affirm. This role combines hands-on IAM operations, automation, and production software engineering to make identity services more reliable, scalable, and easier to operate.
 You will help run core access lifecycle processes, troubleshoot production issues, and automate repetitive work. You will also build and maintain backend services, APIs, and integrations that connect identity platforms with internal systems.
 Software engineering is a must-have. You will work primarily with SailPoint and enterprise identity integrations, with CIAM-adjacent Auth0 work where enterprise systems intersect with customer identity. This is a strong opportunity for an engineer who wants to develop deep IAM expertise without stepping away from hands-on coding.
 What you’ll do
 Run and improve IAM operations, including access lifecycle work, requests, certifications, and issue resolution
 Automate repetitive processes with scripts, services, and workflow improvements
 Build and maintain production backend software, APIs, tests, and integrations
 Connect SailPoint and workforce identity events with internal systems
 Build a paved path that enables Affirm employees to create modern internal tools with Auth0

title: Senior iOS Engineer, Guest & Host
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
 The Community You Will Join:
 The App Experience & Frameworks team’s mission is to empower product teams at Airbnb to build high-quality experiences by providing the feature foundations and unified app wide product frameworks. The Senior iOS Engineer joining this team will play a critical role in the end-to-end development of new product features across guest and host experiences, driving features from prototypes to production launch in collaboration with cross-functional partners across Design, Product, Marketing, Data Science and partner Engineering teams.
 This team is part of the App Foundation organization, focusing on building common solutions for Tech-wide priorities like Performance, Event Logging, App Configuration (AirParam), and builds app-wide features and frameworks including Host Task System, Navigation, and the Early Access Program.
 The Difference You Will Make:
 As a Senior iOS Engineer on the App Experience & Frameworks team, you will build features and frameworks that enhance the app experience for millions of guests and hosts. You will work on horizontal product concerns such as app navigation, announcement scheduling, frameworks that power host required actions, and more, to lay the product foundation for bringing a more unified customer experience across platforms.
 Success in this role looks like shipping reliable, scalable, and polished iOS experiences that both bring direct customer delight and enable feature teams to build and experiment faster.
